title: File:Namdang stone bridge.JPG
author: Gitartha Bordoloi
description: Namdang stone bridge, located a few kilometers away from Sivasagar town, was constructed in 1703 during the reign of Ahom king Rudra Singha. It was cut out from a single piece of stone.
period_note: Early 18th-century bridge; not evidence for a 15th-century town layout
